title: Workflow Run State v1.0
description: Workflow run state file written to projects/{slug}/_state/workflows/{run_id}.json by every multi-step skill (spec §10). Captures resume/retry/approval state without any state-machine library — discipline is JSON-write only. Each skill updates this file before/after every step. Status transitions: running → (awaiting_approval ↔ paused) → done | failed. The skill exits when status becomes awaiting_approval; when the user replies yes/no the next session loads the file, sets approval_decision, and continues. The steps[] array is monotonically grown; never mutate prior entries except to flip status/ended_at on the currently-running step. Cross-reference: steps[].output_ref typically points at events.jsonl entries (events.schema.json) or master.xlsx#sheet anchors. run_id pattern aligns with §10 example: {project_slug}-{YYYY-MM-DD}-{hash4}.

schema_version.description: Schema version pinning. ADR-019: const "1.0" baseline; v2 migration için kullanılır (Phase 14+ schema skew detection).

run_id.description: Unique workflow run identifier. Convention: {project_slug}-{YYYY-MM-DD}-{hash4} where hash4 is a 4-char hex token disambiguating same-day runs (spec §10).

skill.description: Slug of the skill that owns this run. Must match a known skill name (kebab-case, also enforced by skill-frontmatter.schema.json).

project_slug.description: Project this run belongs to. Matches projects/{slug}/ directory name and project-config.schema.json.project_id.

status.description: Top-level run status. Five closed values per spec §10. awaiting_approval triggers approval_meta requirement; failed triggers failure_reason requirement.

started_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp set when the run begins (first step transitions to running).

ended_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp set when status becomes done or failed. Absent while running/awaiting_approval/paused.

paused_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp set when status transitions to paused (user said no to an approval gate or external pause). Cleared/ignored on resume.

resumed_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp set when a paused or awaiting_approval run resumes back to running.

current_step.description: Zero-based index into steps[] of the currently active or most recently active step. Used by skills to know where to resume.

total_steps.description: Total number of steps the skill plans to execute. May exceed steps.length while the run is mid-flight.

steps.description: Append-only-ish history of step executions. Each step records its lifecycle. New entries are appended; existing entries only update status/ended_at/output_ref/approval_decision/error in place.

name.description: Human-readable step name (e.g. 'fetch_gsc', 'project_excel', 'approve_publish'). Stable identifier across runs of the same skill.

status.description: Step lifecycle state. Mirrors run-level status plus pending/skipped for orchestration.

started_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp set when step transitions from pending to running.

ended_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp set when step transitions to done/failed/skipped.

output_ref.description: Pointer to the artifact produced by this step. Conventions: 'master.xlsx#sheet_name' for Excel writes, 'outputs/reports/{date}-name.md' for markdown, 'events.jsonl#event_id' for log entries, 'inbox/...' for ingest sources.

approval_prompt.description: Question shown to the user when status=awaiting_approval. One sentence; the skill exits after writing this and waits for the user reply in a fresh session.

approval_decision.description: User reply captured on resume. null while awaiting; 'yes' continues, 'no' pauses or fails the run depending on skill policy.

error.description: Short error message set when status=failed. Detailed traces belong in events.jsonl, not here.

outputs.description: Map of named artifacts the run produced (e.g. {"report": "outputs/reports/2026-04-30-monthly.md"}). Keys are stable artifact names chosen by the skill; values are artifact path strings. Read by downstream skills via REFERENCE_INDEX conventions.

errors.description: Accumulated run-level error messages (distinct from per-step errors). Empty unless status reached failed at least once.

approval_meta.description: Required when status=awaiting_approval. Captures who must approve, what is being approved, and an optional deadline. Also retained after resume for audit.

approver.description: Identifier of the human or role expected to approve (e.g. 'user', 'editor@example').

subject.description: Short label for what is being approved (e.g. 'publish_5_drafts', 'apply_redirects', 'schema_changes').

deadline.description: Optional UTC deadline; if missed, scheduler/skill can auto-pause or escalate.

failure_reason.description: Required when status=failed. Captures classification + short message. Detailed stack traces remain in events.jsonl.

code.description: Coarse failure classification used by retry policy.

step_index.description: Index into steps[] of the step that triggered the failure.

created_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp written once when the run JSON file is first persisted. Used for retention and ordering.

updated_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp updated on every disk write. Skills set this to now() on each step transition.

retry_count.description: Retry attempts (incremented on each failed → running transition via retry()). ADR-019 additive bump; default 0 backward-compat.

reason.description: Free-text reason captured when a run is paused via pause(reason=...). Previously accepted but silently dropped (P1-10); now persisted into the run JSON and mirrored into the emitted workflow event 'notes' metadata.

notes.description: Free-text approver notes captured when an awaiting_approval run is approved via approve(notes=...). Previously accepted but silently dropped (P1-10); now persisted into the run JSON and mirrored into the emitted workflow event 'notes' metadata.

retry_history.description: Append-only archive of prior terminal attempts, preserved across retry() calls. Before retry() clears ended_at, the prior {ended_at, failure_reason} is pushed here so the terminal timing of earlier attempts is never lost (P1-10).

ended_at.description: ended_at of the failed attempt that was retried (copied before retry() cleared it).

failure_reason.description: failure_reason of the failed attempt that was retried. Mirrors the top-level failure_reason shape.
